stories.title: Houthi missile attack on Aden presidential palace kills five, injures 16
stories.summary: Five people were killed and 16 injured when five ballistic missiles struck al‑Maashiq Palace in Aden, the seat of Yemen’s internationally‑recognised government. Yemen’s information minister said the prime minister and other ministers were unharmed; the health minister said the victims were palace guards and civilian staff. The Houthis said they targeted the “Saudi enemy’s military operations headquarters” in the city.

stories.title: India’s unemployment rate holds at 5% in September 2026
stories.summary: India’s overall unemployment rate stayed at 5.0% in September 2026, unchanged from the previous month. Rural unemployment fell to 4.2%, urban unemployment rose to 6.9%, and urban female unemployment increased to 9.2%. The Labour Force Participation Rate was 55.5% year‑on‑year and the Worker Population Ratio rose to 52.7%.
stories.why: The figures show a stable labor market overall while indicating rising joblessness among urban women, which is relevant for policymakers and businesses.

stories.title: RBI clarifies FERR not required for market‑making, ECB coupons or NR dividends
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India clarified that the foreign exchange risk reserve (FERR) requirement does not apply to banks that engage in inter‑bank market‑making or proprietary trading. It also confirmed that the rule does not affect interest payments on external commercial borrowings (ECBs) or dividends payable to non‑resident investors. Banks must keep the FERR only until one day after a derivative contract ends.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: Seven crew missing after drone attack leaves tanker ablaze off Romania's coast
stories.summary: A search and rescue operation involving boats and helicopters is now continuing in rough seas, Romania's authorities say Seven of 12 crew members are missing after a drone attack left a chemical tanker ablaze off Romania's coast on Thursday morning, naval authorities say. Romanian President Nicușor Dan confirmed that the Wine Trader and another chemical tanker in the area, the Yara J, had both been struck by drones - the Yara J on Wednesday.

stories.title: India's current account deficit narrows to $5.2 billion in August as capital account surplus hits $50.6 billion
stories.summary: India's current account deficit narrowed to $5.2 billion in August, compared to $6.1 billion a year earlier. The capital account surplus increased substantially to $50.6 billion, influenced by non-resident deposits of $83 billion.

stories.title: School headscarf ban sparks rare protests in Azerbaijan and row with Turkey
stories.summary: "You are telling me, I can't come to school?" says a teenage girl in a navy blue Islamic headscarf, captured on video challenging a staff member at the entrance to her school. The footage has been shared widely on social media, and shows a group of girls in hijabs standing behind her applauding as she continues: "Why should I have to give up my religion?" Last Monday the education ministry in Azerbaijan began enforcing new uniform rules, turning away female pupils wearing hijabs.

stories.title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
stories.summary: Meta has launched what it calls the “most capable” open-weight model in the United States. The new model, which leverages 816 billion parameters and a 1 million token context window, claims to offer superior performance to other popular open-weight models, according to evaluation results released by Meta on Thursday.
